quest.title: The Bunkoku Enigma
quest.description: You're still quite curious about what the Bunkoku Puzzle really is, and so you decide to ask Yabe...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x3, Light Realm Sigil x40, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: #Hey, you're {NICKNAME}, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if you remember my name, but I'm Yabe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, hello, Yabe.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Hello, hello, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, you're quite the hotshot, aren't you? Taking on the Raiden Shogun first and then braving the darkness of Enkanomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, you could say that.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Great! So I have a lead on a certain treasure trove, but it'll make for a dangerous trip. Are you interested?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Though I've always been a fan of mysterious stuff, I'd prefer not to put myself in any great danger.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds interesting. Tell me all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: So, I found this when I was patrolling the Dainichi Mikoshi.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Though it appears to be a mere stone slate, I believe it's the key to finding Bunkoku's Secret Treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bunkoku's Secret Treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Well, the name is all I know, as not many detailed accounts of Byakuyakoku have survived through Watatsumi Island's history.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: One version says that Bunkoku was the second Prime Minister in Byakuyakoku's history. He and the Sunchild bled the people white through heavy taxation and made a huge fortune. After that, he hid his treasure in a secret chamber inside the Dainichi Mikoshi.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Finally, he concealed the treasure chamber using the Sunfire Phantasms and summoned vengeful spirits and tainted beings from the Ley Lines to guard it.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Bunkoku probably had an ancient-sounding name, something like "Tyeseus" of sorts. But nobody would care to record the story of a despicable traitor in detail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, let's get back to the stone slate.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Indeed, it is probably the key to unlocking Bunkoku's treasure chamber. According to my years of experience in kaidan and mystery investigation—

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: It reads... Um... It's on the tip of my tongue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It won't hurt to be honest, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Actually, I found the slate in the storage room inside the Dainichi Mikoshi, and next to it lay a note that records both the ancient script and its translation.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: It seems that documents written during the transitory period all came with a translation alongside them. According to this note, the stone slate is directly related to the Bunkoku Puzzle.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: It also says that there are eight stone slates in total. So far, we've only recovered one. According to the note, the secret chamber is in a nearby location.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to take a look there? I don't care about the treasure, to be honest. I'll be content so long as I get to see the Bunkoku Puzzle through to the end.

talks.objective: Look for clues based on the direction Yabe pointed out

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to take a look there? Please refrain from pushing yourself too hard. "Mysterious" is synonymous with "dangerous," after all.

talks.objective: Investigate the area to look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, did you hear that? Seems there's some sort of strange noise coming from up there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like there's strange markings on the ceiling over that way, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go up there.

talks.objective: Trace the source of the sound and look for clues
Investigate the secret passage in front of you

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like this is the key to unlocking the treasure chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The stone slate fits right in. From the size of it, it can ... fill up a third of this space, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A ninth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem! That's what Paimon means. Anyway, you get the picture.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we just need eight more stone slates in here, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, you're so annoying! Okay, got it, got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, we keep a look out for similar stone slates.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, we're all outta leads now — We don't even know where to start looking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea. Since the note says that there are eight stone slates in total, there should be some mention of their whereabouts, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, let's go look for Yabe then.

choices.text: We could leave it to fate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're giving up already? Paimon thinks we can go ask Yabe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since the note says that there are eight stone slates in total, there should be some mention of their whereabouts, right?

choices.text: There are eight of them in total.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: You're back. Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There is indeed a secret chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: So it is all true?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: According to the note, all the other stone slates are divided into three groups and kept in three areas.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: I suppose you have the basic map that Tsumi drew? Let me mark them out for you there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why didn't you tell us earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Well, these areas are full of danger. If the secret chamber turns out to be pure fiction, then there's no point exploring any further at all.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: My conscience wouldn't be clear I made you go into the dark depths just for a prank our ancestors once pulled.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Alright then, these places are where the stone slates are kept.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: I—I just hope I'm interpreting it right...

talks.objective: Investigate the areas to retrieve the stone slates
Investigate the area and retrieve the stone slates
Investigate the area and retrieve the stone slates
Place the stone slates back in their proper places

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was wondering how the secret chamber would open after we pieced the slates together... Like, would there be a portal or a secret passage in the stone wall, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Turns out that the pattern itself became the door!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't this lead us back to the previous room below?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't think so. This giant hole just chugged open! It's definitely more than meets the eye.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When Paimon thinks about it, Yabe did say that the chamber is concealed by the Sunfire Phantasms.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like this is the key to unlocking the treasure chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The stone slate fits right in. From the size of it, it can ... fill up a third of this space, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A ninth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem! That's what Paimon means. Anyway, you get the picture.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this means that we only need to place the other eight stone slates we find in here, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're so annoying! Got it, got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we've found all the stone slates, let's put 'em all inside.

choices.text: There are eight of them in total.

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: That's weird. Where is he?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a Shade of Tokoyo here, huh? Could he be... Bunkoku?

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: Don't you dare take me for that despicable, craven traitor! My name is Koyanagi.

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: But since you know the name Bunkoku, you didn't follow me here with ill-intent, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: It took my friend tons of reading and careful analysis to locate Bunkoku's Secret Treasure. By no means will I allow you to snatch it away from me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're mistaken. We just, uh... got down here by chance! Yup, it was just pure luck, yes-siree!

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: Hmph. Then scram.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (To think that someone made it down here in the past...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Did they beat us to the treasure?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thought so too. Had they successfully found the treasure, the Bunkoku Puzzle wouldn't have remained a mystery till today.

response.speaker: Koyanagi
response.text: What are you two murmuring about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no. Had they successfully found the treasure, the Bunkoku Puzzle should've been solved long ago. It wouldn't have remained a mystery till today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, this is... a final fragment! But why is there a ninth?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And besides, where's Bunkoku's Secret Treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm, let's see if it fits into the pattern upstairs later.

talks.objective: Speak to the afterimage in front of you
Investigate the room to search for clues
Investigate the device and close the secret passage

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: What are you doing sneaking around this time?

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: How... How could this be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: I attacked my friend... How could I have...

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: I must've been possessed by one of the vengeful spirits summoned by Bunkoku. It must've controlled me...

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: I mean, this treasure is nothing compared to our friendship! I—I'd never have been tempted to attack him over some petty pile of treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: He trusted me so much that he even invited me here to witness the unveiling of Bunkoku's Secret Treasure... I...

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: I would never do something like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the truth was concealed by the last fragment, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He needs some time alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He does.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's return and tell Yabe what happened.

talks.objective: Defeat the defiled spirits that emerged

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, Ya... Ya...

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Yabe! My name is Yabe!

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: *sigh* Come on, remember a guy's name, would you? Don't tell me you've also forgotten what I asked you to help me with...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s just joking. We've uncovered the truth of Bunkoku's Secret Treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Yabe what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: So, there really is a secret chamber concealed by the Sunfire Phantasms? But then something else happened along the way...

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: ...And the chamber is guarded by vengeful spirits and tainted beings that can control people's minds. That's... horrifying. I'm glad I didn't go with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you scared that you might hurt us?

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: No, I was more scared that you might give me a good beating.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm content... but just a little frustrated, too, strangely. Thank you. Unfathomable though the puzzle appeared, everything adds up just fine when you consider the presence of elemental powers... and somehow, that kinda kills the excitement.

dialogues.speaker: Yabe
dialogues.text: The Bunkoku Puzzle has finally been cracked, and I'll be sure to let the whole world know once I get back!

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: Hehe, hahaha! This is the conjunction of the three realms, which happens only once every century. If the treasure is hidden now, it will surely become a mystery for the ages...

dialogues.speaker: Koyanagi
dialogues.text: No, I—I'm not...
